name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write the Bernstein-Vazira
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit for hidden string '1100011' directly in OpenQASM 3 (no Python circuit building - generate the QASM text), load it with qiskit.qasm3, and verify the recovered string. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
